summary: Documentation only, re-reviewed after merging origin/main (d1e7285, with ADR-0101..0108 and the code of PRs 176, 178, 180-184). Changes against main: design/portability.md (portability roadmap; phase 0 and phase 1.2/1.3 now marked done with links to ADR-0101..0108, phase 1.4 marked in review as PR 179 / ADR-0120, the 'Why' section states what phase 0 already fixed), eleven ADRs with status proposed (0109-0119) and the regenerated ADR index (119 ADRs, consecutive). No code, configuration, version, workflow, checker or review-policy change; nothing proposed here is built. All file and line references in ADR-0109..0119 were re-checked on the new main and corrected where the merged PRs moved them (ha.py, app.py, agent/config.go, proxy.py, agent app/facts/ollamawatch/heartbeat/gpu/guard, poll.py, nodes.py, scheduler.py, config.py, install.sh, config.example.yaml, ollamaupdate.py); contexts that the merged PRs changed were rewritten to the new facts without changing the decisions: ADR-0109 (problems are now structured records pullable from /metrics, GET /admin/problems and the UI per ADR-0101; pushing still only through Home Assistant), ADR-0112 (gpu.probe and gpu_present per ADR-0102; still one NVIDIA GPU or none), ADR-0113 (game switch per ADR-0103 and no GPU busy detection without a GPU per ADR-0102; a server with a GPU still cannot switch off foreign VRAM, utilisation or guard), ADR-0111/0112 (the passthrough allowlist, facts and heartbeat are now part of the protocol specification of ADR-0107 and its conformance tests, which each runtime or the gpus[] list must update). Security content of the proposals is unchanged from the earlier review: ADR-0118 forbids loading code named by configuration (TM-16); ADR-0109 bounds webhook egress (B9, TM-08) and proposes per-node MQTT logins; ADR-0110 keeps the cloud checks before the backend (B6/B7, TM-05); ADR-0111 keeps a per-runtime allowlist in the signed binary with a TM-11 review per runtime; ADR-0112 loads vendor libraries only from the system path and fails closed (B8, TM-14); ADR-0114/0115 keep owner isolation, deletion replay and memory safeguards (B4/B5, TM-09, TM-12); ADR-0116 keeps pinning, hash locks, non-root and provenance (TM-14, TM-16); ADR-0117 keeps router-chooses-version-only (B8, TM-13); ADR-0119 fails closed on unknown tool formats (B6, TM-05). The texts name no host, address, person or deployment path.

findings.evidence: Pre-existing, re-checked on d1e7285: router/skirnir_router/registry.py provision_bundle (lines 142-154) still puts the router's own MQTT username and password (read_mqtt_password, line 135) into the provisioning bundle of every approved node with MQTT enabled. Attacker prerequisite: control of an approved node. Impact: publish or subscribe on the broker with the router's identity, e.g. forge router state topics read by home automation. Controls today: operator approval of nodes (ADR-0009), the per-node policy switch policy.mqtt, broker-side ACLs if the operator configures them. Confidence high.
findings.resolution: Not introduced by this change (documentation only, no code touched). ADR-0109 proposes a per-node MQTT login or none in the bundle, with a negative test that the bundle carries the router's password only when no per-node login is configured; the fix belongs to the PR that implements ADR-0109.

tests.evidence: base d1e7285, security_relevant false; 13 changed paths (design/portability.md, ADR-0109..0119, docs/adr/README.md).
Public-change scan: 0 finding(s); manual review of the added lines found no host, address, person or ops path.

limitations: Documentation only; the proposals are reviewed as designs, not as code. Each implementing PR needs its own review against the then-current code.
Line references in ADR-0109..0119 are for origin/main at d1e7285; the open shape-protocol PR (179) touches proxy.py and may move the proxy.py lines cited in ADR-0110.
The pre-existing shared MQTT credential is recorded here but not added to the risk register; that is the maintainer's call.
ADR-0101..0108 listed in reviewed_paths were read for the facts they establish (to rewrite the contexts and the design document), not re-reviewed; they were reviewed in their own PRs.
